==Description==
'''Laser Stadium''' is an easy [[PVP]] [[Maps|map]] that also appeared in the [[PVP Test]].

==Design & Path==
'''Laser Stadium''' was, as the name suggests, a large stadium made out of colorful neons. Audience seats could be seen on the sides of the map, alongside some pillars. In the middle of the map there was a giant black and neon purple floor which contained two platform, one red and another blue. This platform contained a small hologram map which had small 2D trees and houses, a large cliff and a black road.

The path for this map started at one edge of the map and ended at another. The path consisted of a straight path which entered two loops, then entered another straight path that lead to the exit.

==Interactive Map==
{{Map:Laser Stadium}}

==Strategy==
*The loops on this map benefit short ranged towers like the [[Electroshocker]], [[Shotgunner]] or [[Brawler]] greatly, as enemies will loop around, allowing these towers to attack them multiple times.
**The loops that appear on this map are also great spots for the [[Ace Pilot]], due to them matching its circle flight path.
*Support towers should be placed in a way that covers both loops, for towers placed outside and inside the loop.
*The layout of this map allows towers that can damage multiple enemies at a time to be quite effective, as enemies will tend to occupy the same space often.

==Trivia==
*The intermission lobby listed SorenDerg as one of the creators. However, SorenDerg was not actually involved in creating this map and has not been active in the Tower Defense Simulator community since early 2023.
*'''Laser Stadium''' is the finished version of [[PVP_4]].
